intent: Form field that opens a month grid to pick one date or a date range.
useWhen: A date in a form or filter
Need a typed-looking field whose overlay is a month grid
A period between two dates (mode range), like invoice due vs last month for a report
doNotUseWhen: A schedule of events — use Calendar
A range with named presets such as This month — use DateRangePicker

mode.note: single is one YYYY-MM-DD. range is { start, end? }. Named presets are DateRangePicker.

value.note: controlled. string when single; { start, end? } when range. YYYY-MM-DD.

defaultValue.note: uncontrolled. string when single; { start, end? } when range.

onValueChange.note: (date: string) => void when single; (range: { start, end?: string }) => void when range

size.note: Trigger size; overlay month grid is sm when size is sm, else md. No lg on the field.

placeholder.note: Defaults to Pick a date, or Pick dates when mode is range

minDate.note: Passed to the overlay month grid

maxDate.note: Passed to the overlay month grid

name.note: Hidden input for forms. Range submits start/end, like 2026-08-10/2026-08-18

describedBy.note: Field wires hint and error ids onto the trigger

requirements: error shows the danger border and Field's error text via aria-describedby; no aria-invalid on the trigger button (button does not support it)
Trigger is a button with aria-haspopup=dialog, aria-expanded, aria-controls
Overlay is role=dialog aria-modal labelled Choose date (or Choose dates in range) and contains DatePicker’s own month grid
Range: first click sets start, second click sets end and closes. Escape discards an in-progress range
Tab stays in the overlay; Escape and pointer down outside close and return focus to the trigger. Escape closes only this overlay, not a parent Modal, Drawer or AlertDialog
Month-grid overlay is at least as wide as the trigger and anchors to its end, growing toward the start edge when the trigger is narrower than the grid, so it fits in drawers without horizontal scroll
Must have associated label via Field or a visible label pointing at id
error described by Field via describedBy
built-in labels (previousMonth, nextMonth, chooseDate, chooseDates) come from KitLabelsProvider; English by default

doNot: Do not wrap DatePicker in Popover. The field owns its overlay. Do not invent a local calendar, DatePickerDialog, PeriodPicker, DualCalendar, or native input type=date
Named presets such as This month or Last 30 days — use DateRangePicker
Do not use two DatePickers for start and end — use mode=range
Do not use the event Calendar as a date field
Do not add built-in label, hint, error text, help, or hideLabel — wrap with Field
Do not add time, Density, or a third field size
snippet:
<Field label="Start date" htmlFor="start-date"><DatePicker id="start-date" value={date} onValueChange={setDate} /></Field>
<Field label="Report period" htmlFor="period"><DatePicker id="period" mode="range" value={range} onValueChange={setRange} /></Field>
